tagline: Create Todoist follow-up tasks from HubSpot CRM activities and sync deal tasks automatically
metaTitle: HubSpot Todoist Integration: Deal Follow-Ups as Tasks
metaDescription: Create Todoist follow-ups when HubSpot deal stages change and log completed tasks back to HubSpot. GAIA preps meetings too. See the setup steps.
intro:
HubSpot tracks every deal, contact interaction, and pipeline stage, but turning those CRM events into personal action items requires constant manual translation. Sales reps and account managers often rely on a personal task manager like Todoist to stay on top of their follow-ups, but keeping it in sync with what's happening in the CRM is a full-time job in itself.

GAIA automates this translation layer. When a deal moves to a new stage in HubSpot that requires a follow-up, GAIA creates a Todoist task with the deal name, company, stage, and due date pre-filled. When a contact opens a proposal or a meeting is logged, GAIA can trigger a follow-up task automatically. Completed tasks are logged back to the CRM as activities so your records stay accurate without double entry.

This is built for sales reps, account executives, and customer success managers who want a personal task manager for their workflow discipline while keeping the CRM as the authoritative system of record for all customer interactions.

useCases.title: Create follow-up tasks from deal stage changes
useCases.description: When a deal advances to a new pipeline stage, GAIA creates a follow-up task with the deal name, contact, company, and a suggested follow-up due date so no deal progresses without a next action.

useCases.title: Task creation from contact activity
useCases.description: When a contact opens an email, visits a key page, or submits a form, GAIA creates a timely follow-up task so you can strike while engagement is highest without manually monitoring activity feeds.

useCases.title: Log completed Todoist tasks back to HubSpot
useCases.description: When you complete a task linked to a deal or contact, GAIA logs the activity back to the CRM with a timestamp and note, keeping your records accurate without requiring you to open the CRM.

useCases.title: Meeting prep task generation
useCases.description: The day before a scheduled meeting, GAIA creates a preparation task with the contact name, company, deal stage, and recent activity summary so you're always ready without last-minute scrambling.

useCases.title: Overdue deal follow-up alerts
useCases.description: GAIA monitors for deals that haven't had activity in a defined period and creates urgent tasks for the responsible rep, ensuring stalled deals get proactive attention before they go cold.

howItWorks.step: Connect Todoist and HubSpot to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize your task account and your CRM portal in GAIA's integration settings. GAIA uses private app tokens for the portal and OAuth for the task account to access only the pipelines, deals, and contacts you specify.
Choose which CRM events create tasks, deal stage changes, email opens, meeting completions, or form submissions, and define the task template including due date rules and project destination.

howItWorks.step: GAIA automates the CRM-to-task and task-to-CRM loop
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors the portal in real time for trigger events and creates tasks automatically. When those tasks are completed, GAIA logs the activity back to the CRM so both sides stay current.

faqs.question: Can GAIA work with custom HubSpot pipelines and deal stages?
faqs.answer: Yes. During setup GAIA reads your portal's custom pipelines and deal stages so you can configure triggers and task templates for any stage in any pipeline, not just the default ones.

faqs.question: Does GAIA support contacts and companies in addition to deals?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can create tasks from contact activity events such as email opens, form submissions, and lifecycle stage changes, in addition to deal-based triggers.

faqs.question: How does GAIA log completed tasks back to the CRM?
faqs.answer: GAIA creates an activity note associated with the relevant deal or contact when a linked task is marked complete. The note includes the task title, completion timestamp, and any notes you added to the task.
